records.kind: statutory arrangement seating two governments on the bank's board
records.summary: Under the statutes of the Banque Centrale des Comores, signed in Paris on 22 April 2008 and still in force, the bank's board has at most eight members, half of them designated by the French Government and half by the Government of the Union of the Comoros, so every seat is filled by one of the two governments. The Governor is named by the President of the Union of the Comoros, on a proposal from the Minister of Finance. This is a standing arrangement with no end date; the bank's board approved a new draft of the statutes on 28 June 2024, but that text still awaited promulgation by the Union's President at the end of 2024.
records.source_title: Statuts de la Banque Centrale des Comores (Banque Centrale des Comores)
records.quote: compose de huit membres au plus designes pour moitie par le Gouvernement francais

parties.role: designates half of the central bank's board

records.kind: head of state reconstitutes the bank's board
records.summary: President Mahmoud Abbas issued a presidential decree reconstituting the board of directors of the Palestine Monetary Authority, acting on a recommendation from the Cabinet and from the Authority's Governor. Three of the eight seats are held by virtue of law: the Governor as chairman, the Deputy Governor, and a representative of the Ministry of Finance, named as Majdi Al-Hassan. The report does not name the law that gives those seats.

records.kind: statutory arrangement letting the head of the executive appoint the bank's board
records.summary: Macao's Chief Executive, Sam Hou Fai, appointed Vong Sin Man, a worker of the Statistics and Census Service, as a member of the board of directors of the Monetary Authority of Macao, from 1 July to 31 December 2025. The order is made under article 50 of the Basic Law and articles 4(2)(a), 14 and 15(1) and (2) of the Monetary Authority's Statute, approved by Decree-Law 14/96/M of 11 March 1996, which the order shows is still the law in force: under that statute the head of the executive appoints the Authority's board. The pay for the post is borne by the Monetary Authority. This is a standing arrangement with no end date.
records.source_title: Despacho do Chefe do Executivo n.o 120/2025 (Boletim Oficial da RAEM, Serie II, n.o 27)

records.kind: statutory arrangement letting the government direct the bank
records.summary: The Royal Monetary Authority Act of Bhutan 2010, passed by Parliament on 2 June 2010 and in force from 22 June 2010, lets the executive direct the central bank: section 149 says the Royal Government may from time to time issue such directives to the Authority as it may consider necessary after consultation with the Governor, in the public interest, and must report them to Parliament. Of the Board's seven members, four are appointed by the Government and one of those must come from the Ministry of Finance. The Governor is appointed by the Druk Gyalpo on the Prime Minister's recommendation, and may be removed the same way, though only on a finding by a committee of permanent incapacity, incapability of carrying out the duties, or breach of the code of conduct. The Royal Government sets the Governor's salary and the board members' fees. The Act repealed the 1982 Royal Monetary Authority Act. This is a standing arrangement with no end date.
records.source_title: The Royal Monetary Authority Act of Bhutan 2010 (Parliament of Bhutan)
records.quote: The Royal Government may, from time to time issue such directives to the Authority

parties.role: may issue directives to the central bank and appoints four of its seven board members

records.kind: statutory arrangement letting the executive appoint the bank's board
records.summary: Under the statutes set by law no. 118/AN/11/6eme L of 22 January 2011, the Banque Centrale de Djibouti's board is made up of the Governor and six administrators appointed by decree, so every seat other than the Governor's is filled by the executive. The bank's own 2024 annual report states that composition, calls the board the bank's supreme organ and cites the 2011 law, which shows the arrangement still stands. This is a standing arrangement with no end date. The record rests on the bank's annual report, not on the text of the law, which could not be obtained.
records.quote: Il est compose du Gouverneur et de six administrateurs nommes par decret.

parties.role: appoints the central bank's six administrators by decree
central bank whose board is appointed by decree

records.summary: Botswana's Directorate of Public Prosecutions, headed by Stephen Tiroyakgosi, called in Bank of Botswana governor Moses Pelaelo to hear his version of the P100 billion the state alleged had been looted from the central bank by former president Ian Khama and former intelligence chief Isaac Kgosi. Tiroyakgosi said Pelaelo told them there is no money missing from the Bank of Botswana, and that the investigation was continuing. The report gives no exact date for the meeting, only that it had happened recently.

records.kind: investigation of state accounts at the bank
records.summary: Botswana's Directorate on Corruption and Economic Crime confirmed it was investigating unaccounted-for funds on government accounts held at the Bank of Botswana, after the Auditor General reported that P22 billion in receipts and payments remained unaccounted for. The Financial Intelligence Agency was reported to have opened its own investigation into the same accounts; its Director General would neither confirm nor deny it. No start date is given for either investigation.

records.summary: A Lithuanian parliamentary commission chaired by Valentinas Mazuronis found that the Bank of Lithuania acted too fast and with too little reasoning when it shut down the bank Snoras in November 2011. Mazuronis said the takeover of Snoras shares in the public interest and the start of bankruptcy proceedings were both hasty and not sufficiently reasoned. The report gives no exact date for the finding beyond the commission's meeting that week.

records.quote: the actions taken by the Bank of Lithuania when shutting down Snoras last November were hasty and lacked proper reasoning

records.summary: Rwanda's Senate summoned central bank governor Claver Gatete, who appeared with finance minister John Rwangombwa, over the Rwandan franc's slide against major currencies; the franc had weakened 1.3 percent against the dollar in the first half of the year. Gatete put the pressure down to speculation, saying investors who heard donors were cutting aid rushed to buy and stock foreign exchange, and said the central bank had put US$327.8 million into the foreign exchange market since 2011. The report gives the week, not the exact hearing date.
records.source_title: Senate summons central bank governor over weakening franc (The New Times, Rwanda)
